method: Opened the floor 30 overview, rendered the east part once (x 10-31.5, y -58..-29.5, grid 1 m, inserts labelled), then went over it in zoomed tiles (x10-16/y-35.5..-30.5; x14-20/y-40..-34; x10-20/y-45.5..-39.5; x10-16.5/y-51.5..-46.5; x13.5-20.5/y-51.5..-44.5; x17.5-24.5/y-49..-44.5; x11-16/y-48.6..-44; x10-17/y-58..-52; x17-24/y-58..-51; x17.5-24.5/y-57..-50; x24-31/y-58..-51 and -51..-44; x18-25/y-35..-30.5; x24.5-31/y-37..-30.5; x18-31/y-46.5..-34 for the hall; close-ups of the middle partition, the glass box and the glazed-room corner), all with grid 0.5 and inserts. Numbers come from prims.pkl: wall-piece rectangles from the A-WALL / A-WALL-PATT / S-COLS hatch loops, A-DOOR / A-DOOR-FRAM block geometry (jambs, leaves, arcs) and exact end coordinates of the pieces; a and b are on the wall centre line at the wall end faces (frames lie inside the opening). I also scanned every wall-piece end for a collinear piece across a gap (this reproduced exactly the gaps above), listed all 14 A-DOOR inserts of the drawing (7 plus the curtain-wall glass door fall in the box), searched every block name for door/window/opening families, looked for arcs outside A-DOOR, checked line coverage along the facade and glass partitions for gaps, and looked at the architect's last-added A-DETL lines (they close the lift gaps and mark the dashed header at the lobby opening). Final check: a render with a marker on each listed centre showed no red door element, wall gap or swing without a marker. Openings just outside the box that I saw and left to the west labeller: sliding cavity door in wall x=9.93 (y -52.30..-54.78), double door at x 7.72-9.60 in wall y=-48.515, door D36 at x 8.06-9.68 in wall y=-35.7, lift gaps at x 5.11-6.51 and 8.02-9.42, gap in the stair core north wall at x 6.77-8.52. Only the allowed folders were read.
